question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Vast
solution: The correct answer is '**Small**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate antonym of the given word '**Vast**' is '**Small**'. • **Vast**: extremely big. (बहुत बड़ा, विशाल, विस्‍तृत) • *Example: a **vast** sum of money...* • **Small**: not large in size, number, amount, etc. [छोटा (आकार, संख्‍या, मात्रा आदि की दृष्टि से)] • *Example: a **small** car/flat/town...* **Correct Answer:__** *Small.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Limitless**: without end, limit, or boundary. (बिना अंत, सीमा या सीमा के) • **Gigantic**: extremely big. (अत्‍यधिक बड़ा; विशाल, विराट) • **Huge**: very big. (बहुत बड़ा, विशाल) 37:Ta9e, The correct answer is '**Sorrow**'.
